test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The teacher asked us to ________ the main idea of the passage in the exam.
solution:
The correct answer is: **summarise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"summarise"** means to give a brief statement of the main points of something. (सारांश प्रस्तुत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The teacher asked us to summarise the main idea of the passage in the exam.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that in the exam, the teacher requested we sum up the passage's key points.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Conclusion **(निष्कर्ष): The end or finish of an event, process, or text.

 
 
• **Example:** In conclusion, the study shows a significant improvement in patient care.
 
 
 
• **Underestimate **(कम आंकना): To estimate something to be smaller or less important than it actually is.
 
 
• **Example:** Do not underestimate the power of a kind word.
 
 
 
• **Plagiarise** (साहित्यिक चोरी करना): To take someone else's work or ideas and pass them off as one's own.
 
 
• **Example:** It's important not to plagiarise when writing research papers.
